resolved_findings.problem: Initial joint token audit checked cross-arm prompt agreement but did not bind complete selection/scoring artifacts or prove selected score and SFT token/context equality.
resolved_findings.resolution: The reviewed revision requires --selection-dir for audit and training, binds its complete file inventory, validates all 180 complete selection slots and corresponding scoring events/cost ledger/arm labels, and compares each eligible selected label's actual SFT prompt hash, action-plus-EOS hash, prompt/target token counts and causal context hash to its frozen adapted-reference score. Training re-reads and revalidates these bytes and requires exact recomputed joint-audit equality.
resolved_findings.verification: Read the actual token_audit call path through encoded_record and verify_score_sft; independently ran mismatch and complete-artifact fixtures.

verified_contracts: Exactly 100 optimizer updates, each interleaving four original BC and four recovery examples, with 400+400 total exposures. Independent private shuffles use seeds 613300 and 613301 and reshuffle on wrap; the exact ordered index schedule is shared across all arms.

All arms require identical ordered anchor identities and task/history/observation/admissible contexts. Only the action target differs. The student allowlist strips oracle, future, score and state fields, including extra history fields.

The original canonical60 BC bytes are fixed and must decode to 349 examples. Every label and every scheduled exposure is token-audited, with target, prompt and input totals for all three arms. Different target lengths are reported rather than padded or resampled.

The frozen original base and complete canonical final adapter inventory are verified. PeftModel.from_pretrained loads the existing adapter with is_trainable=True, one default adapter only, and trainable parameters are restricted to LoRA. No new stacked adapter or prior optimizer state is loaded.

A fresh AdamW uses learning rate 0.0002 and weight decay zero. Training uses seed42, bfloat16, gradient norm clipping1, context2048/action64 and action-plus-EOS loss weighted by target tokens over the complete eight-example accumulation window.
The GPU guard is called before tokenizer/model loading and the worker accepts only logical cuda:0. Imports and pure fixtures load no real tokenizer, torch model or simulator.

Started forwards and completed backward exposures are recorded separately. Nonfinite loss/gradients, exceptions and stage budget failures cannot yield a complete training summary. Only successful step100 saves an eligible final adapter; its training state binds exact token/exposure totals, protocol, initial adapter, schedule and joint audit.
Final adapter inventory is saved only after successful final serialization and is included in completion evidence. Training loss is expressly not interpreted as task success.
scope_limits: This is approval of the reviewed local training component, not training adoption or launch authorization. Actual training remains conditional on the complete fixed train-only diagnostic gate passing.

The future controller must enforce physical GPU2 through launch_gpu.py, immutable adopted input/source/runtime inventories, cumulative budgets, process ownership and cleanup, and recheck each final adapter before any held-out rollout.
The component does not authorize held-out evaluation. All three complete final adapters must be locked before the first research48 evaluation, as required by candidate v2.
The review used code inspection and pure fixtures; it makes no claim about real training stability or eventual task-success gains.
